note: Both sets are nearly identical in content and errors. Both correctly extract the formulas for generator and aerodynamic torque but both fail to capture the derivative dot ($\Delta\dot{\Omega}$) in the PID control law (Equation 7-10), representing it as $\Delta\Omega$ instead. Set B is slightly more consistent in entity naming (using 'generator torque (TGen)' in claim 2 vs 'TGen' in Set A), but this is minor.
